what: Add rustc ProjectionElem::UnwrapUnsafeBinder(Ty) to hir_ty::mir::ProjectionElem (crates/hir-ty/src/mir.rs) so MIR lowering can make unwrap_binder!(place) a place, as rustc does. Without it hir-ty-mir lowers wrap/unwrap_binder! values as a Transmute cast (same layout) but refuses unwrap_binder! in place context (borrow/assign through it) with a NotSupported error naming the missing projection (crates/hir-ty-mir/src/mir/lower/as_place.rs). Not urgent for the compile; needed for superset-of-rust on #![feature(unsafe_binders)].
